description: The plot illustrates the relationship between answer popularity and three different values. The x-axis is labeled “Answer Popularity” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue line, marked with circular data points and connected by a solid line, represents “Accuracy” and begins at approximately 0.55 at an answer popularity of 0, decreases to a minimum of approximately 0.42 at an answer popularity of 40, then increases to approximately 0.86 at an answer popularity of 160. A green line, marked with triangular data points and connected by a solid line, represents “Confidence” and begins at approximately 0.84 at an answer popularity of 0, increases to a maximum of approximately 0.94 at an answer popularity of 80, and then decreases to approximately 0.91 at an answer popularity of 160. A red line, marked with diamond-shaped data points and connected by a solid line, represents “Alignment” and begins at approximately 0.65 at an answer popularity of 0, decreases to approximately 0.56 at an answer popularity of 40, then increases to approximately 0.83 at an answer popularity of 60, and remains relatively stable at approximately 0.82 to 0.83 until an answer popularity of 160.
